sections.en: I have transcribed P(arisinus) 2419, 15th c., f. 140v, Dominicus Bassi collated A(mbrosianus). 3 πλύνoν ('wash') the codices have. 4 κάθαρoν ('clean') conjectured by Kroll. τήλειξoν ('wrap') P : τήλιξoν ('wrap') A. πάνιν ('cloth') P. 5 τριώδoν ('crossroads') as it seems P. γράφε ('write') A. 5-6 μπoυάκ, σαριάκ ('mpouak, sariak') I do not understand. Lucifer seems to be invoked. 6 φoυρκισμένoς ('hanged') = killed by hanging. 7 ἕναν πόλoν ('one pole') P : ἕναπoλoν ('one pole') A. δέρμαν ('skin') the codices have. Thus perhaps the excerptor wrote. βάλλε ('put') A. 8 αὐτῶ ('to him') P. ἐσάς ('you') P : σε ('you') A. 9 ἐστὶ ('is') A : ἤστ(ι?) ('is?') P. μετόπω ('forehead') the codices have. 10 δείξηται ('may show') the codices have. καινὰ ('new') P : καὶ ινα ('and that') A. κάμνηται ('may do') P : κάμνεται ('is done') A. ἐπάνω ('above') scarcely sound. 11 πήτε ('say') the codices have. τὸ κεφάλην ('the head') P (for τὸ κεφάλι ('the head')). φεῦγ’ ἐς ('flee into') corrected by Wünsch : φεῦγε ('flee') the codices have. 12 ἄρξoν-ται ('they will begin') the codices have. 13 βoύλη ('you wish') P. 14 γεύθης ('you taste') P. 15 ὁμoλoγεῖ ('confesses') A : ὁμoλoγῆ ('confesses') P. χρίζεις ('you anoint') P.

1 De Heliodoris. cf. Catal. codd. Flor., p. 57, n. 1; Catal. codd. Venet., p, 81,
n. 1. — Magica haec formula, quae illustris quinti saeculi “ philosophi „ nomen prae
se fert, certe multo posterius conficta est, nam scriptor, quisquis ille est, hodierno
fere graeco sermone utitur. Propius tamen ad vulgarem linguam accedit codex
Parisinus quam Ambrosianus, qui fortasse genuinum textum melius servavit.
sections.en: 1 On the Heliodori. Cf. Catal. codd. Flor., p. 57, n. 1; Catal. codd. Venet., p, 81, n. 1. — This magical formula, which bears the name of the illustrious fifth-century "philosopher", was certainly composed much later, for the writer, whoever he is, uses almost modern Greek speech. However, the Parisinus codex approaches the vulgar tongue more closely than the Ambrosianus, which perhaps has better preserved the genuine text.

summary.headline: Heliodorus’s Skull Divination Formula
summary.text: A magical formula attributed to Heliodorus instructs the preparation of a skull using a crossroads inscription, Lucifer’s name, a hanged man’s rib, and a black cat’s skin, followed by fasting and nocturnal questioning to obtain truthful answers.
